standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness of the base change of a morphism flat at a point, and lifting of specialisations along a flat morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-base-change-flat (proof line 4967); Algebra, Section algebra-section-going-up (proof line 4970)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first makes the projection from the base change flat at the lifted point, and the second produces a specialisation upstairs lying over the given one.

standard_prerequisites.name: Points of a fibre product and base change of the relative assassin
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Schemes, label schemes-lemma-points-fibre-product (proof line 4973); Divisors, label divisors-lemma-base-change-relative-assassin (proof line 4975)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first produces the required point of the fibre over the lifted specialisation and the second shows it is a relative associated point of the pulled back module.

core_obligations: Prove the contrapositive of the universal statement: given an impurity above the point, base change the morphism and lift the specialisation to the base change, choose a point of the fibre over the lifted specialisation corresponding to a generic point of a fibre product of residue fields, and use base change of the relative assassin to see it is a relative associated point (proof lines 4962-4976).

Observe that the closure of that point maps into the closure of the original point and hence misses the fibre over the lifted specialisation, so the lifted data form an impurity of the pulled back module above the lifted point (proof lines 4977-4981).

Conclude both parts: this is the contrapositive of the universal statement, and because an elementary etale neighbourhood stays an elementary etale neighbourhood after base change, the same argument gives the non universal statement (proof lines 4982-4985).
proof_roadmap: Base change and lift the specialisation, then choose the associated point (proof lines 4962-4976).
Check the closure misses the fibre, giving an impurity upstairs (proof lines 4977-4981).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that purity, and universal purity, along a fibre descend along a morphism that is flat at the point: if the pullback is pure then so is the original (statement lines 4948-4960, tag 05J9). The proof is the contrapositive and requires a real construction: from an impurity downstairs one base changes, lifts the specialisation using flatness and going up, chooses a point of the fibre over the lifted specialisation corresponding to a generic point of a residue field fibre product, verifies by base change of the relative assassin that it is a relative associated point, and checks that its closure misses the fibre so that an impurity upstairs results. The lifting of the impurity is the substance, so the claim is H2.
